summary: AMEND for one bounded principal-capacity gap. Duplicate free aliases are rejected, but a free alias remains eligible when another worker record for its principal holds an unacknowledged active task or expired lease. Both counterexamples reproduce against frozen plan.mjs. Thirty supplied tests pass, as do typed-guard, source/hash/protocol/human-binding and stale-dispatch negative checks. The actual epoch-08 live registry has six distinct principals and no aliases; its R201/R207 eligibility and 400/400 native assignment remain valid. This finding is future alias occupancy, not observed current double booking.

blockingFinding.cause: free filters active/lease on each worker record, then checks uniqueness only among those free records; it never excludes a free record whose principal is occupied on a different unavailable record.

reproductions.observed: newAlias appears in nativeSpec.workers and review eligibleWorkers
reproductions.expected: p2 contributes no new capacity until coordinator reconciles the active task.

reproductions.expected: Time expiry alone must not free principal p2.

blockingFinding.requiredAmendment: Derive occupied principals from every active/lease record; prevent those principals from entering free capacity through any alias. Preserve truly inactive historical aliases, duplicate-free-principal rejection and producer/principal self-review exclusion. Add active-alias and expired-lease-alias regressions.
